author: GamingBolt
description:
However, the Arknights fan in me feels a familiar sense of wonder, whether it's of the art style or the world-building. The action RPG part wants to dive into combat more than ever, and the open-world enthusiast...well, I'll appreciate dense regions that still offer plenty of content. 

With everything we've seen thus far, it remains to be seen if Endfield can compete with the titans of industry. Never mind upstart competitors like Where Winds Meet or future threats like Ananta or Silver Palace.

One thing is for sure, though: It's offering a premium experience, right out of the gate, while defying numerous norms. And that's certainly more than something.
title: After Where Winds Meet,  Arknights: Endfield Might Be The Next BIG THING

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Resident Evil franchise has experimented quite often with its formaula, but few spin-offs were as ambitious or as divisive as Resident Evil Outbreak 2. Originally released in 2005, the game doubled down on co-op–focused survival horror but struggled to find its footing at the time. 

This video looks back at Resident Evil Outbreak 2 in 2026, stripping away all traces of nostalgia and historical context to evaluate how it holds up in the modern gaming landscape. From its slow, scenario-based survival loop and emphasis on shared vulnerability to its dated controls, we try to examine in detail where Outbreak 2 still succeeds, where it falters, and whether its old-school design philosophy can still resonate with players who are accustomed to modern controls and quality-of-life conveniences.
title: Resident Evil Outbreak 2 Review

author: GamingBolt
description:
If you didn't get the chance to try out Code Vein back when it was released, or perhaps didn't get to finish the story entirely, or perhaps just interested in a recap, we've got you covered! 

The story in the first game is quite the tale, bringing a lot of emotional heft and unexpected revelations to your character's adventure. There's interesting characters with complex backstories, a past that gradually reveals itself to give context to the present, and of course, a big bad whose actions have some serious consequences. 

They're all crucial ingredients in a recipe that the best titles often follow, and this is a story that we're glad to be telling in anticipation of an even better one when Code Vein 2 releases later this month.
title: The Full Story of Code Vein 1 - Before You Play Code Vein 2
